_note: NASA-linked chemistry where cited; fertility, wash residuals, and oxide summaries are game balance layered on S10/S28.

profiles.name: Phoenix wet chemistry
profiles.oxides_note: Basaltic fines; salts dominate toxicity for crops more than bulk oxides.
profiles.why: Phoenix wet chemistry found ~0.4–0.6 wt% perchlorate and alkaline pH ~7.7.

profiles.name: Rocknest (Gale)
profiles.oxides_note: Rocknest scoops: perchlorate-bearing dust over basaltic sand.
profiles.why: Curiosity’s Rocknest scoop showed perchlorate salts in Gale crater fines.

profiles.name: Jezero crater floor
profiles.why: Game analog for Jezero surface fines; perchlorate load scaled toward Gale/Phoenix in-situ chemistry.

profiles.name: Elysium Planitia fines
profiles.why: Game analog for equatorial dusty fines; chemistry mirrored on Gale Rocknest perchlorate detections.

profiles.name: Utopia Planitia fines
profiles.why: Game analog for mid-latitude northern plains; perchlorate threat kept in the Phoenix/Gale range.

profiles.name: Arcadia ice-margin regolith
profiles.why: Game analog for ice-rich northern plains; chemistry biased toward Phoenix wet-chemistry salts.
